title: MiniMax Video 01 Director Image to Video
description: Generate video clips more accurately with respect to initial image, natural language descriptions, and using camera movement instructions for shot control.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: Text prompt for video generation. Camera movement instructions can be added using square brackets (e.g. [Pan left] or [Zoom in]). You can use up to 3 combined movements per prompt. Supported movements: Truck left/right, Pan left/right, Push in/Pull out, Pedestal up/down, Tilt up/down, Zoom in/out, Shake, Tracking shot, Static shot. For example: [Truck left, Pan right, Zoom in]. For a more detailed guide, refer https:

inputs.name: image
inputs.tooltip: URL of the image to use as the first frame

inputs.name: prompt_optimizer
inputs.tooltip: Whether to use the model's prompt optimizer
